milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The jungle planks form the main structure centered at approximately (0, 2, 8) relative to spawn. The player needs to navigate toward the structure and face it. max_distance=16 is generous since the structure is large and visible from far away. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the structure.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The jungle wall sign is a small block placed at (1, 2, 6) on the front face of the structure. A smaller max_distance of 8 is used because wall signs are small and require closer inspection to identify. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the sign.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The brown wall banner is placed at (-2, 3, 5) one block in front of the structure's left column. max_distance=10 is used because banners are moderately sized and visible from a reasonable distance but require the player to look at the correct side of the structure. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is facing toward the banner.
